label: copy phase: fed-back input 3, late in the copy, next output l/g/3/2
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost entirely (98% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is the digit 3. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or at recall_idx 0-2. It fires more often later in the copy: the rate rises steeply with t and recall_idx, so it is concentrated in L=8-9 sequences and near the end (to_go 0-2). Among input-3 steps it prefers ones where the token being output is l, g, 3 or 2. The strongest activations are at 3 followed by 3 or l at the last copy steps (e.g. ...3 3 l <DEL> ... [3][3]). A small amount of residual mass sits on fed-back l, g or 2 inputs. in_tok==3 & recall_idx>=4 alone covers 97% of mass, but only 13% of those steps are active. Adding the output-token condition gives about 0.6 precision and 0.56 recall. Activation looks graded by position, output identity and other context that this predicate does not capture.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 3, l, g, 2, -, <DEL>; least: w, 0, t, n) and the token being output (most: l, g, 3, 2, q, h; least: w, -, a, m); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, t=17, recall_idx=8.
